How the two search modes differ

Both answer questions about your people. They differ in how much they read first, and so in what they cost.

Standard · the everyday choice

Reads a one-line summary of every household: names, Prospect Score, home value and total giving. It also searches your notes for whatever is relevant. Good for “who mentioned wanting to host a Shabbos dinner?”, where the answer is in a note.

Power search · slower, and costs more

Reads the full profile of every household: the score breakdown, giving history, research and business background, plus your notes. For big jobs like “make me a list of people to ask for a major donation, with talking points.” It checks with you before it runs.

If you’re not sure, use Standard.
